requirements.label: Shared football kernel
requirements.remaining: Implemented and covered by repository tests for shared kernel 2013.7: the sourced 2012 field-position model (a real drive per possession drawn from the start spot and game state, real kickoff, punt and turnover transition records, late-game score and time cells, real chains and snap counts), field-goal accuracy by distance, extra points, safeties, turnovers on downs, clock-bounded halves, kickoffs and the overtime state machine, carrier-true descriptive call labels from the committed 2013 call-family map (unknown families fail closed), zero ledger-coherence violations, depth-chart attribution, full public snap ledger, player-stat reconciliation, band audit and season-stat aggregation. Kernel 2013.7 acceptance (250-game synthetic sample): every structural, coherence, defect, isolation and determinism criterion passes, but three graded drive-model band rows read OUTSIDE (clock drive share, clock-expired drives per team game, field goals made per team game), so tests/test_usage_bands.py fails until that is resolved; see library/2012_field_position_model_calibration.md. The private service must report the repository kernel version before any event closes.
